rule_text.name: 702.250a
rule_text.rule: Glitch represents two static abilities that function while the spell with glitch is on the stack. “Glitch [cost]” means “You may pay an additional [cost] any number of times as you cast this spell” and “For each time you chose to pay this spell's glitch cost, change its text by removing one instance of text in [] brackets.” Paying a spell’s glitch cost(s) follows the rules for paying additional costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.

rule_text.name: 702.250b
rule_text.rule: If a spell’s controller declares the intention to pay any of that spell’s glitch costs, that spell is “glitched.”

rule_text.name: 702.250c
rule_text.rule: If a glitched spell is copied, the choice of which instances of bracketed text were removed will be copied as well.

rule_text.name: 702.250d
rule_text.rule: Persistent glitch is an activated ability and variant of the glitch ability found on permanents. “Persistent glitch [cost]” means “[Cost]: Change the text of this permanent by removing one instance of text in [] brackets.”
